policy.reason: Bulk selection already required a claimed handler, but individual routes and issue-detail buttons still admitted manual diagnostics to a free AI patch. Eligibility now applies before cost, cache replay or internal execution.
policy.trusted_private_explicit_rewriters: Uncatalogued private utilities and the separate keyword workflow may still supply a bounded server-side callable. They are not public anomaly eligibility; unknown public keys and unknown direct model fallback refuse.

measured_boundaries: All 131 manual catalog keys, extra variants, empty and unknown keys refuse individual deep correction, URL AI preview, GitHub preview and GitHub confirmation after project access checks but before payer, journal/cache, quota, GitHub or provider calls.

Preparation and application refuse unsupported keys despite forged plans. Direct patch refuses every manual catalog key even with cached source and an injected rewriter, including six exact keys whose suffix is part of the catalog entry.

Real FastAPI authentication, project ownership and CSRF are exercised with non-admin test accounts: owned requests refuse without charge; unowned projects return 404. External provider and GitHub helpers are simulated.

Supported uppercase/whitespace requests share a normalized preview and one debit. Four older exact raw-key receipt cases, completed or blocked, recover the paid preview without new model work, writes, extra operation or debit.

Manual detail pages hide automatic buttons even if a saved plan claims auto_fixable. Protected families keep the GitHub action on deep-fix and hide unrestricted URL AI preview. Missing template policy context fails closed.
Current recommendations are displayed for manual diagnostics, while original plan files and historical PR information remain available.

owned_browser_measurement.scope: Actual rendered UI and request routing on an owned loopback HTTP fixture, not successful real GitHub correction, billing integration or a deployed-user journey.
